# apicurio Provider

Terraform provider for Apicurio Registry (v2/v3).

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "apicurio" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:3080"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Apicurio Registry base URL, e.g. `http://localhost:3080`.

### Optional

- `api_version` (String) Apicurio API flavor to use. One of: `v2`, `v3`. If unset, the provider probes for v3 and falls back to v2 (best-effort).
- `auth_header` (String, Sensitive) Optional literal header in the form `Header-Name: value`, e.g. `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Overrides `token` if set.
- `basic_auth` (Attributes) Optional HTTP Basic authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--basic_auth))
- `ca_bundle_path` (String) Optional path to a PEM CA bundle to trust when connecting to HTTPS endpoints.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) If true, TLS certificates are not verified (use only for dev/test).
- `oidc` (Attributes) Optional OpenID Connect (Keycloak) client credentials flow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc))
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Optional bearer token. If set, provider sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

<a id="nestedatt--basic_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `basic_auth`

Required:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Basic auth password.
- `username` (String) Basic auth username.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc`

Required:

- `client_id` (String) OIDC client id.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OIDC client secret.
- `token_url` (String) Token endpoint URL (for Keycloak: `<issuer>/protocol/openid-connect/token`).

Optional:

- `auth_style` (String) Optional client authentication style: `auto`, `in_header`, or `in_params`. Defaults to `auto`.
- `extra_params` (Map of String) Optional extra token endpoint parameters (e.g. audience).
- `scopes` (List of String) Optional OAuth2 scopes.
